# AI Bot Governance & Review Policy

## 🚫 Automated PR Reviews: GitHub Copilot & OpenAI Reviewers Disabled
- **No Automated Code Review Scans**: Do not execute automatic Pull Request review sweeps, code-scanning bots, or token-consuming automated annotations in this repository.
- **Designated PR Reviewers**: Only **CodeRabbit** and **Qodo** are configured and permitted to perform automated code reviews on this codebase.

## 🛠️ Codebase Architecture & Standards
- **Backend**: Python 3.10+ with FastAPI, Asyncio, Pydantic, Dataclasses, Edge-TTS, and standard library tools.
- **Frontend**: React 19 + Vite + ESM modules. Clean Nord/Skyrim styled theme.
- **Modding Integration**: Skyrim Special Edition Strings (`.strings`, `.dlstrings`, `.ilstrings`), ESP plugin format, and Dynamic String Distributor (DSD) format.
